items.prompt: 围绕“职业选择是否主要由个人兴趣决定”写一个完整论证段，包含让步、立场和理由。
items.starter: Personal interest matters when people choose a career, but it is not the only factor.
items.reference: Personal interest matters when people choose a career, but it is not the only factor. Although enthusiasm may encourage people to work harder, access to reliable information and training also shapes what is possible. A choice that ignores income, location and future demand may be difficult to sustain. Therefore, sensible career planning should balance interest with practical conditions.
checklist: 是否先承认合理的一面
结尾是否收束而非重复

items.prompt: 写一封简短邮件：说明无法参加活动、解释原因，并提出一个替代安排。
items.reference: Dear Alex, I am sorry that I cannot attend the workshop on Friday because I have an important appointment at the same time. Could we meet next Monday to discuss the main points instead? I would also be grateful if you could send me the reading list. Best regards, Li Ming

items.prompt: 根据数据写一个图表说明段：线上预约占比从 2019 年的 28% 升至 2025 年的 64%，电话预约从 52% 降至 21%。概括趋势、比较变化并给出一种可能原因。
items.starter: The figures show a clear shift in how people make appointments.
items.reference: The figures show a clear shift in how people make appointments. The share of online bookings rose from 28 percent in 2019 to 64 percent in 2025, while telephone bookings fell from 52 percent to 21 percent. Online booking therefore became the dominant method over the period. One possible reason is that users can choose a time without waiting for an office to open. Nevertheless, services should retain alternatives for people who cannot easily use digital tools.
checklist: 是否同时写出两个趋势
是否进行了比较而非逐项抄数
原因是否标明为可能解释
是否避免 every、always 等过度概括
